s: June 16, 2017 - This factory is the place where the fabric is cut and sewn into Naked and Famous’ bestselling Weird Guy fit. This fit is comfortable from the waist to the hip with a standard mid-rise and a slight taper from the knee to the hem. Each pair is completed with a four-button fly, YKK hardware and a vegetable tanned leather patch that will darken and develop over time. Another cool feature of the Massdrop x Naked & Famous Ichiban is that all jeans are individually numbered.

s: June 1, 2017 - As with all Naked and Famous jeans, they seem a bit better and hardier than their pricetag, but this is particularly amazing with a pricetag of $100 even. These would probably retail in the 150-200 range. When I handed these jeans to my friend, he immediately said to me - "These are cool guy jeans." I'd probably agree with him - the color is sweet and dark, and if they fade as Massdrop and N&F say they will, these are going to be awesome.
